_doc: What plays where (D100, D185). `scenes`: a scene key -> the set it hears. `places`: an area's id, or the place on the land tile walked onto, or a moment's key -> the set heard there instead of the scene's (EventBus.place_entered). `dialogues`: the start of a dialogue's id -> the set heard while it is open. `sets`: tracks by name, one picked at random when a set has several, each at `volume_db`. The fan covers (crossing_field, peace_sign, unravel) are never named here (D100). angelic and bday_project are Ewan's; memory_theme, world_ending, tower_floors, stormreach and crater are in-house stand-ins made by tools/make_music.py until his cues arrive (docs/28). Where each plays and how loud is Inferred (agenda items 107, 108).
